items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I read an interview that somebody did with Baby that has not been published... And Baby claims that when he was working the Streckfuss line, that Bill Slingerland or whatever his first name was -- this had to be in the early '20s. Old Man Slingerland.

ctx.x: He never used one the whole time.

I read an interview that somebody did with Baby that has not been published. A guy down in New Orleans has it. And Baby claims that when he was working the Streckfuss line, that Bill Slingerland or whatever his first name was -- this had to be in the early '20s.
